findings.title_en: Worker without a hard hat in the forklift operating area
No marked pedestrian walkway in the forklift operating area

summary_en: Two findings were recorded: one high severity and one medium severity. The most urgent item is a worker without a hard hat in the forklift operating area. Forklift traffic in this area must stop immediately until the worker wears a hard hat and the pedestrian route is separated from the forklift route.
